home-one.featureTitle: The drawing is a request. The jig is a guarantee.
home-one.featureText: Most fit-out problems are translation problems: a designer draws something, a third-party carpenter interprets it, and the interpretation is what gets installed. Owning the workshop removes the translation.
home-one.featureText2: Shop drawings come from the same model as the 3D you approved. Every panel is numbered, dry-assembled in the factory, photographed and signed off before it travels to site.

home-three.heroTitle: Interiors drawn, made and installed by one studio
home-three.heroText: Woodex is a design-and-build interior practice. We plan the space, draw every joint, manufacture the joinery in our own workshop and install it with our own teams — across commercial, residential, retail and hospitality projects in Pakistan.
home-three.heroImageAlt: Reception lobby with a terrazzo counter and a planted arrival court
home-three.svcListText: Fifteen services grouped into design, fit-out and specialist. Hover a row to preview the work.
home-three.projListText: Residential, workplace, retail, hospitality and healthcare — all delivered under one contract.
home-three.splitText: Woodex began in 2014 because our founders kept watching good drawings get ruined on site. So we bought the machines, hired the craftsmen and built the design studio around them.
home-three.splitText2: Eleven years later the same principle runs everything: the people who draw your space are the people who build it.
